floorPlans.introduction: View the published island master plan and regional location map. Individual apartment drawings remain unavailable in the reviewed public sources.
floorPlans.note: Both complete original sheets retain their notices and community scope. They establish the island setting. Individual Marina apartment layouts, room dimensions, contracted unit areas and final revisions remain unavailable in the reviewed public material. Obtain the applicable developer apartment plan before relying on a unit configuration.

review.imagery: Root reviewed all 22 cached website resources and six original brochure resources. Twelve selected architectural and residential-concept renders retain Marina or master-community scope. The card uses the proposed waterfront plaza and residences. Three current published residence interiors remain concepts with unit applicability unverified. Explicit magnific AI-edited media, the chatgpt.site hero poster, villas, generic lifestyle portraits, repeated mobile crops and duplicate plaza render were excluded.
review.floorPlans: Root visually reviewed all 42 original brochure spreads and both delivered full original community drawings. No individual Marina apartment plan or contracted area is established. The on-page introduction, selector and note state that these are master/regional context sheets. Gated apartment drawing controls were left untouched. No villa drawing was borrowed.
review.location: Root read the whole original regional map and factsheet page 3. Five published community drive estimates remain qualified. The original master plan is separate from the regional map. No surveyed apartment entrance, precise pin or kilometre distance was inferred.
review.provenance: Normal-GET receipts preserve original website image URLs, document URLs, dates, bytes and SHA256. Original embedded brochure resources retain their PDF physical-page attribution. Complete original sheets and PDF notices remain unchanged. Existing text research and protected ownership remain preserved.

unavailable: Individual Marina apartment plans, contracted unit areas and revisions, confirmed final interiors, surveyed apartment entrance coordinates and kilometre journeys remain unavailable or unverified.
